blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Oxford Heights fell from 19 in June to 15 in September, and 10 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 9.8% of Port Coquitlam’s 153 houses listed.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Oxford Heights?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 houses listed in Oxford Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Oxford Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Oxford Heights had a sales ratio of 33%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Oxford Heights from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 10 houses sold in Oxford Heights over those 4 months, out of 72 in all of Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Oxford Heights?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
